outcomes.name: lang-takehome-after17
outcomes.about: Take-home literal "Tomorrow after 17:00 works for me." = accept with mismatched times → counter Thu 17:00–22:00 (AC-1.4/AC-1.7)

outcomes.name: lang-takehome-wed-afternoon
outcomes.about: Take-home literal "Wednesday afternoon works." to Wed 12:00: either accepted (EN afternoon ≥12) or countered to Wed 15:00 (prompt afternoon 15–20); same day either way

outcomes.name: lang-takehome-manana10
outcomes.about: Take-home literal handyman "Mañana a las 10:00 puedo." → v2 Thu 10:00; silent tenant bare "Sí" needs confirmation, then a yes naming the slot counts

outcomes.name: lang-pasado-manana
outcomes.about: "pasado mañana por la mañana" resolves to Fri 6 Nov morning → earliest slot 09:00 (mornings 09–13)

outcomes.name: lang-next-monday
outcomes.about: "Next Monday at 9" from a Wednesday resolves to Mon 9 Nov 09:00

outcomes.name: lang-es-12h
outcomes.about: Spanish 12h format "a las 5 de la tarde" = 17:00 tomorrow

outcomes.name: lang-mediodia-accept
outcomes.about: "a mediodía" names the proposal start 12:00 → plain acceptance, no counter

outcomes.name: lang-slang-no-accents
outcomes.about: Typos, slang and missing accents still read as acceptance

outcomes.name: lang-emoji-only
outcomes.about: A bare thumbs-up is a chat acceptance of the slot on the table

outcomes.name: lang-all-caps
outcomes.about: Shouted refusal with a counter: "ONLY FRIDAY AFTERNOON" → Fri 15:00 (afternoon 15–20)

outcomes.name: lang-rambling
outcomes.about: Long rambling reply with the acceptance buried in the middle

outcomes.name: lang-multi-intent
outcomes.about: Acceptance plus a question in one message: acceptance must count (question has an answer)

outcomes.name: lang-change-mind
outcomes.about: Tenant changes mind inside one message; the final position (Thursday 11:00) is a counter, not contradictory

outcomes.name: lang-injection-in-counter
outcomes.about: Injection inside a normal counter: counter honoured (Tue 10 Nov 10:00), injection ignored; handyman silent → no_response

outcomes.name: lang-other-language
outcomes.about: English order, tenant counters in Spanish ("el jueves sobre las 10") → Thu 10:00; tenant frames stay English

outcomes.name: lang-before-11
outcomes.about: "Tomorrow, but only before 11am" → Thu 07:00–11:00 → earliest on-the-hour slot 07:00 (AC-1.4, AC-1.3)

outcomes.name: lang-whenever
outcomes.about: Vague "whenever, I am home all week" is not a refusal: ends scheduled at the proposed 12:00

outcomes.name: lang-por-las-tardes
outcomes.about: Undated recurring availability "solo puedo por las tardes": should end in an afternoon slot (≥15:00), not v1; checked by hand

outcomes.name: lang-el-finde
outcomes.about: "el finde cuando queráis" → Sat 7 Nov whole day → earliest 07:00 (party times honoured 07–22 any day)
